# Midway Ventures LLC

> Rents one heated shop on US-310 just west of Lovell, Wyoming (Big Horn Basin): 36 x 45 ft (1,570 sq ft inside the walls), 16 ft ceilings, a private bathroom and a private office. Rent online.

## Shop facts (as of November 2026)
- Size: 36 x 45 ft on the building plans; 35 ft 7 in x 44 ft 1½ in inside the walls (about 1,570 sq ft); 16 ft ceilings
- Office: 10 × 10 ft, with a window; bathroom: 5 × 5 ft; closet: 4 ft 7 in × 5 ft
- Doors: overhead main door, clear opening about 15 ft wide x 14 ft 10 in tall, WiFi app-controlled opener; 3 ft walk-in door
- Heated: yes, overhead natural gas forced-air furnace
- Utilities included: Water, sewer and trash
- Water spigot and floor drain: yes
- Power: One 220V outlet, standard 110V outlets for the rest
- Private bathroom: yes
- Private office: yes
- Base rent: $1,250 per month before payment fees (the rental page adds about 1.75% for ACH or about 4% for card)
- Status at last check: open to rent
- Office size: 10 × 10 ft
- Access hours: 24-hour access
- Lease term: 12-month lease

## Business facts
- Name: Midway Ventures LLC
- Address: 1781 US Highway 310, Lovell, WY 82431
- Contact: Pete Baxendale
- Phone: (307) 254-0578
- Rent online or join a waitlist: https://midwayventuresllc.ccstorage.com/find_units/loc_b07c6c20aebd052257591ce9104c7cea

## Drive times to the shop (fastest Google Maps route)
- Lovell, WY: 4 minutes (2.7 miles)
- Cowley, WY: 4 minutes (3.5 miles)
- Byron, WY: 5 minutes (4.7 miles)
- Powell, WY: 22 minutes (19.6 miles)
- Greybull, WY: 36 minutes (35.2 miles)
- Basin, WY: 44 minutes (42.8 miles)
- Cody, WY: 47 minutes (43.4 miles)
